baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرُّسُلَ ... مَاذَآ أُجِبْتُمْ ... لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ
baseline_models.mechanism: A single severe occasion gathers previously dispersed message-bearers and asks about the reply received by them. Their collective denial of knowledge sets the partial, distributed observation of messengers against God's exhaustive knowledge of what remained hidden.

activation_trace.role: A momentous occurrence supplies the bounded occasion on which the audit becomes present.
Joining dispersed elements supplies the assembly of separately situated witnesses into one hearing.
Carriers of messages supply the representative witnesses whose missions are being reviewed.
Replying to speech makes reception, rather than merely delivery, the object of the question.
Knowledge as disclosure creates the contrast between the messengers' limit and the divine superlative.
What is screened from sight names the domain in which complete reception cannot be certified by the messengers.

changed_reading.before: God gathers the messengers and asks them to report what people said.
changed_reading.after: God convenes a cross-mission reception audit whose question exposes the gap between locally observed replies and the hidden total history known only to Him.

baseline_models.mechanism: Divine saying and messenger saying frame a passive reference to the replies of absent communities. The expected middle speech is never quoted; instead, the messengers decline total knowledge. This makes the silence between the two sayings functional: audible answers do not by themselves settle what reception became.

activation_trace.role: Two acts of voiced speech form the outer frame while the communities' speech remains unvoiced inside it.
The bearer of carried speech supplies one end of a communication chain whose receiving end is under review.
The ordinary return of speech supplies the missing middle that the question evokes without reproducing.
Hiddenness prevents the unquoted replies from being treated as transparent evidence of inward or eventual reception.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents a complete question-and-answer exchange.
changed_reading.after: The exchange is built around an absent middle: reported human answers are withheld because surface speech cannot exhaust the hidden response to a message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context twice restricts the messenger's charge to conveying the message, while assigning knowledge of unseen, disclosed, and concealed response to God. The focus question therefore tests the boundary between completed transmission and reception that remained inward, concealed, or historically unfinished.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearers identify the office whose responsibility is then explicitly bounded.
Making the message reach its audience supplies the messenger's stated endpoint, not control of its reception.
Conduct in hiddenness supplies a response-domain unavailable to ordinary messenger observation.
Divine disclosure of reality supplies the knowledge that exceeds the messenger's delivery duty.
What emerges openly supplies the observable side of audience response.
Concealment supplies the unobservable side that prevents a messenger from certifying total reception.

structural_cues: 5:92 and 5:99 both restrict the messenger's burden to delivery.
5:94 places a consequential human response in the unseen.
5:99 balances what people disclose against what they conceal under divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded delivery office and divine knowledge of open and concealed response; I infer that total reception lies outside the messengers' epistemic remit. A live alternative is that لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا is pure deference rather than a jurisdictional distinction.

changed_reading.before: The messengers are asked whether their audiences answered them.
changed_reading.after: The messengers are asked across a boundary the context has established: delivery can be completed, but the full inward and eventual reception cannot be certified by its carriers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questions can force disclosures whose consequences the questioner cannot bear, while communities also fabricate claims and repeat inherited speech unsupported by knowledge. Against that sequence, the messengers' answer practices disciplined non-attribution: they will not turn fragmentary audience speech into a total claim about response.

activation_trace.role: Requesting an answer supplies the risky pressure by which concealed matters may be forced into speech.
Forced emergence supplies disclosure whose mere visibility can harm rather than clarify.
Fabricating a lie supplies the danger of manufacturing an answer and assigning it upward.
Speech contrary to truth supplies the failed alternative to the messengers' restrained answer.
Attributed saying supplies a caution against converting inherited communal claims into warranted knowledge.
The forebears' lack of disclosed knowledge separates repeated speech from reliable reception.

structural_cues: 5:101-102 links insistent questioning and disclosure to a history of disbelief.
5:103 presents false attribution to God.
5:104 places inherited communal speech beside lack of knowledge and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful forced disclosure, fabricated attribution, and inherited speech without knowledge; I infer that the focus reply refuses to fabricate a collective verdict from such speech. The alternative is a narrower eschatological formula of humility with no backward polemic.

changed_reading.before: لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا sounds like an empty failure to answer.
changed_reading.after: لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا is evidentiary discipline: the messengers refuse to invent, inherit, or over-attribute a verdict about their communities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The forecast of everyone's return, collective assembly, and God's informing them of their deeds makes the later divine question non-inquisitive. God is already the informer; the question publicly stages responsibility and makes the history of response answerable before the gathered messengers.

activation_trace.role: Return to the point of origin supplies the movement into final review.
Joining everyone together anticipates the focus assembly and broadens it beyond an isolated interview.
God's delivered report supplies disclosure to the judged rather than information acquired from them.
Intentional deeds supply the accountable history that divine informing will expose.

structural_cues: 5:105 forecasts universal return to God, assembly of all, and divine disclosure of their deeds.
5:109 reuses collective gathering but places messengers in the first interrogated position.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies God as the one who informs the returned community; I infer that His question in 5:109 performs adjudication and disclosure rather than seeking missing data. The live alternative is that messenger testimony is still elicited for a public record despite divine foreknowledge.

changed_reading.before: God asks the messengers in order to obtain their report.
changed_reading.after: God's foreknown question stages a public reckoning: it makes communities' reception answerable while exposing that the final report belongs to the divine informer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding witness procedure tests testimony under oath, anticipates concealment and doubt, replaces compromised witnesses, compares rival claims, and threatens returned oaths. The focus assembly scales that evidentiary mechanism upward: messengers testify only within what they can know, before the Knower from whom nothing is concealed.

activation_trace.role: A declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the standard that the final witnesses must not exceed.
Possible concealment supplies the evidentiary defect the procedure is designed to expose.
A sworn statement distributed onto its bearers supplies formal accountability for asserted knowledge.
Disturbing doubt supplies the condition under which testimony requires procedural testing.
Competing parties' claims to right supply the adversarial comparison of first and replacement testimony.
Rival declarations by knowledge show that uttered testimony must still be weighed rather than merely heard.
Returning a statement against its first bearer supplies procedural reversal when testimony fails.
Counter-oaths supply the threat that disciplines witnesses toward testimony on its proper face.

structural_cues: 5:106 installs two witnesses under oath and explicitly forbids concealing God's testimony.
5:107 replaces compromised witnesses and compares the truth-claims of two testimonies.
5:108 explains the procedure through fear that oaths will be returned after prior oaths.
5:109 moves directly from that procedure to God gathering and questioning the messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a local chain for testing fallible testimony; I infer that 5:109 activates it as a macro-hearing in which messengers observe evidentiary limits. The materially live alternative is that 5:106-108 remains a local legal analogy rather than a procedural template for 5:109.

changed_reading.before: The gathered messengers give a devotional answer in an eschatological scene.
changed_reading.after: The gathered messengers occupy a witness stand after a chain-of-testimony passage, and their refusal to overclaim is the exact evidentiary conduct that the preceding procedure sought.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, authorized signs receive sharply different observable replies: concealment of truth as a charge of magic, profession of belief and witness, and a demand for a sign intended to settle hearts and verify truth, followed by warning against later rejection. This spectrum prevents مَاذَا أُجِبْتُمْ from meaning a simple transcript request; it concerns what kind of reception the mission generated and whether that reception endured.

activation_trace.role: Repeated divine authorization supplies controlled provenance for the signs to which communities respond.
Covering the truth supplies one hostile reception of plainly authorized signs.
Heart-settling assent supplies an affirmative reception at the level of declared conviction.
Declaration by knowledge turns professed belief into an offered testimony.
Inner stillness supplies the affective result sought beyond a merely verbal answer.
The heart supplies the inward site whose settled state cannot be read directly from speech.
Desired disclosure of truth supplies an epistemic motive for demanding a further sign.
Truthfulness of speech supplies what the disciples seek to verify despite their prior profession.

structural_cues: 5:110 repeats divine authorization four times, yet one audience labels the signs magic.
5:111 answers revelation with belief and a request to witness that profession.
5:112-113 moves from professed belief to a requested sign meant to settle hearts and establish truth.
5:115 warns that rejection can occur after the requested sign arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies observable declarations, inward motives, and the possibility of later reversal; I infer that the focus asks about the quality and durability of reception, not only quoted words. A live alternative is that the later sequence simply illustrates one messenger's report without redefining the question.

changed_reading.before: مَاذَا أُجِبْتُمْ asks which words audiences spoke back.
changed_reading.after: مَاذَا أُجِبْتُمْ asks what reception authorized mission actually produced across denial, assent, verification-demand, and possible relapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jesus' answer closely reconstructs the focus exchange: God asks what he said, Jesus places any such saying under God's prior knowledge, contrasts divine access to inward reality with his own limit, and repeats the focus's title of Knower of unseen things. He then defines his witness as lasting only while he remained among his community and transfers surveillance to God after his death. This supplies the explicit temporal mechanism behind the messengers' plural disclaimer.

activation_trace.role: Repeated voiced saying reconstructs an accusation, divine question, messenger answer, and test of attributed speech.
Unequal disclosure of reality explicitly distinguishes God's knowledge from the messenger's knowledge.
What lies in the inward self supplies the concealed content to which access is asymmetrical.
The exact focus title assigns all screened realities to divine rather than messenger cognition.
Presence with observation defines the witness's valid temporal field and contrasts it with God's unrestricted witness.
Duration supplies the explicit condition limiting Jesus' observation to the time he remained among them.
Taking the soul supplies the event that closes the messenger's period of direct witnessing.
Continuing observation and watchfulness transfer post-presence knowledge to God.

structural_cues: 5:116 repeats the focus's divine question and messenger answer structure.
5:116 ends with the exact focus formula إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ.
5:117 explicitly limits Jesus' witnessing to the duration of his presence.
5:117 transfers watch over the community to God after Jesus is taken.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact verbal echo plus an explicit handoff from presence-bound witness to divine watcher; I infer that 5:109 generalizes this bounded-witness logic across the messengers. The live alternative is that 5:116-117 answers a uniquely Jesus-specific accusation, though the shared wording keeps the general activation strong.

changed_reading.before: The messengers claim absolute ignorance of how anyone answered them.
changed_reading.after: The messengers decline an omniscient verdict: they can attest what occurred during their presence, but not hidden interiors, later developments, or the complete reception-history watched by God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concluding declaration identifies this as the day on which truthful speech has practical benefit. That turns the messengers' terse disclaimer from an epistemic deficiency into an efficacious truth-act: under total scrutiny, accuracy consists in refusing knowledge one does not possess.

activation_trace.role: The same momentous occasion identifies the focus hearing with the event in which truth is consequential.
Truth of saying supplies the governing quality of testimony on that day.
Benefit rather than harm supplies the concrete outcome of exact, non-inflated testimony.

structural_cues: 5:119 follows the divine questioning and Jesus' bounded account.
5:119 names the occasion as the day when the truthfulness of the truthful benefits them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal identity and the efficacy of truthfulness; I infer that the messengers' non-overclaim exemplifies truthful testimony. The live alternative is that 5:119 primarily evaluates believers rather than the messenger answers, though the shared day and adjacent hearing sustain the resonance.

changed_reading.before: The reply لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا appears deficient or evasive.
changed_reading.after: The reply is the useful truth of the day: witnesses preserve truth precisely by declining knowledge beyond their evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading activates branch-distant but packet-supplied images of ج و ب as cutting, opening, and disclosure. It remains anchored to the exact focus verb أُجِبْتُمْ and is sharpened by the context's disclose/conceal axis; downstream prose should present it only as an evoked material image, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating cut supplies reception as an effect that breaches a previously closed surface.
An opened gap supplies the space made in a community by its encounter with the message.
Light, uncovering, and clarity supply the possible disclosed result of that opening.
Emergence into view supplies one measurable effect of an opened response.
Continued concealment supplies the resistant closure against which the aperture image works.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only what verbal reply returned.
changed_reading.after: The question may also evoke what opening the missions cut into concealed resistance and how much reception actually came into disclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the packet's split mapping from ج و ب to ج ب ي, so it is morphologically remote and must not be lexicalized as the direct meaning of أُجِبْتُمْ. It remains worth carrying because the same focus occurrence is packet-mapped to collection and converges with repeated gathering; downstream prose should mark it as a collection or harvest resonance only.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and obtaining a yield supplies an exploratory image of responses accumulated through a mission.
Joining dispersed persons supplies the outer collection that resonates with an inner collection of response-yield.
Universal assembly supplies the prior collection movement into which the focus question enters.
The arriving report supplies divine disclosure of what the collected history actually yielded.

changed_reading.before: The gathered messengers are asked to repeat received answers.
changed_reading.after: The assembly may faintly evoke an audit of what response-yield was collected through each mission, while the messengers refuse to claim ownership or total measure of that yield.

strongest_changes: The repeated delivery formula and disclose/conceal contrast separate completed transmission from reception that messengers cannot fully certify.
The 5:106-108 witness procedure turns 5:109 into a macro-hearing where لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا functions as evidentiary restraint.
The near-exact 5:116-117 parallel explicitly defines messenger witness as presence-bound and divine watch as continuing beyond it.
The declaration in 5:119 recasts non-overclaim as the beneficial truthfulness of the day.
summary.what_was_special: The packet first builds a legal chain for testing testimony, then supplies a near-verbatim enactment in Jesus' answer: divine question, unequal knowledge, the title Knower of unseen things, and an explicit handoff from time-limited messenger witness to unrestricted divine watch.
remaining_uncertainties: لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا can still carry total devotional deference alongside the more specific jurisdictional reading.
The forensic relation between 5:106-108 and 5:109 may be a strong local resonance rather than a literal heavenly procedure.
The aperture and collected-yield readings depend on branch-distant images and should remain exploratory rather than enter unqualified translation.
